# The Luxora Collective
## Client Results & Case Studies

### We Don't Just Generate Leads. We Build Revenue Systems.

Most agencies focus on getting more clicks.

We focus on uncovering the hidden revenue already sitting inside your business, then building the systems that turn that opportunity into predictable growth.

Our clients typically come to us facing one or more of the following:

- Inconsistent lead flow
- Low consultation conversion rates
- Poor retention and rebooking
- Weak or nonexistent membership programs
- Revenue tied entirely to monthly promotions
- Front desk teams overwhelmed by follow-up and administrative tasks
- No clear visibility into where revenue is being lost

Our approach combines revenue analysis, patient acquisition, conversion optimization, retention systems, membership architecture, AI automation, and operational strategy.

- Front desk overwhelm
- No scalable follow-up system

### What We Implemented

- AI-powered lead qualification
- Automated follow-up and nurturing
- Consultation process optimization
- Messaging and offer refinement
- Front desk conversion improvements
- Operational workflow enhancements

### Results

- Revenue increased from $37,000/month to $55,000/month in approximately 30 days
- Consultation conversion improved from 34% to 62%
- Significant reduction in administrative workload
- Improved appointment quality and show rates
- Growth achieved without adding staff

**Client Feedback**

*"This wasn't some cookie-cutter marketing agency. Bethany brought real strategy plus trusted growth partners. If you're a med spa owner looking to grow without getting buried in busy work or flaky leads, talk to Bethany."*

— Mike, Med Spa Owner
